name: How long do new pipes last after a whole house repipe?

mainEntity.name: How long do new pipes last after a whole house repipe?

acceptedAnswer.text: After a whole house repipe, new PEX pipes can last 40-50 years, while copper pipes often exceed 50-70 years, sometimes even longer. The lifespan depends on factors like water quality, installation quality, and environmental conditions. With CG Plumbing Solutions, you gain the practical tradeoff of a long-term solution that significantly reduces the likelihood of future plumbing issues, offering peace of mind and protecting your investment for decades.
acceptedAnswer.description: New PEX pipes can last 40-50 years, and copper pipes 50-70+ years, providing a durable solution for decades.
